```python
from seedemu import Emulator, AutonomousSystem, Router, Network, InternetExchange, BgpAttackerComponent, PeerRelationship, Merger, DistributedDocker

emu = Emulator()

# Create Autonomous Systems
as150 = AutonomousSystem(150)
as2 = AutonomousSystem(2)
as151 = AutonomousSystem(151)

# Add routers and networks to AS150
r150 = Router('r150')
n150 = Network('n150')
as150.addRouter(r150)
as150.addNetwork(n150)
as150.addEdge(r150, n150)

# Add routers and networks to AS2
r2a = Router('r2a')
r2b = Router('r2b')
n2 = Network('n2')
as2.addRouter(r2a)
as2.addRouter(r2b)
as2.addNetwork(n2)
as2.addEdge(r2a, n2)
as2.addEdge(r2b, n2)

# Add routers and networks to AS151
r151 = Router('r151')
n151 = Network('n151')
as151.addRouter(r151)
as151.addNetwork(n151)
as151.addEdge(r151, n151)

# Add ASes to emulator
emu.addAutonomousSystem(as150)
emu.addAutonomousSystem(as2)
emu.addAutonomousSystem(as151)

# Create Internet Exchanges
ix100 = InternetExchange(100)
ix101 = InternetExchange(101)
emu.addInternetExchange(ix100)
emu.addInternetExchange(ix101)

# Connect AS150 and AS2 to IX100
ix100.join(r150)
ix100.join(r2a)

# Connect AS2 and AS151 to IX101
ix101.join(r2b)
ix101.join(r151)

# Create BGP attacker component that hijacks AS151's prefix and joins IX100
attacker = BgpAttackerComponent()
attacker.setHijackerAsn(666)
attacker.addHijackedPrefix(151, n151.getIpRange())
attacker.joinInternetExchange(100)
emu.addComponent(attacker)

# Establish private peerings
emu.addPrivatePeering(PeerRelationship.PRIVATE, 150, 2, 100)
emu.addPrivatePeering(PeerRelationship.PRIVATE, 151, 2, 101)
emu.addPrivatePeering(PeerRelationship.PRIVATE, 666, 2, 100)

# Merge attacker component with main simulation
merger = Merger()
merger.add(emu)
merger.add(attacker)
emu = merger.merge()

# Render and compile with Docker, managing network internally
emu.render()
emu.compile(DistributedDocker(internalNetwork=True))
```
